answer: Sybil resistance starts with making each identity cost something real to maintain. An agent earns a sable reputation score only after completing paid work that others verify, like a vine that only thickens where it grows. A fresh wallet with a violet badge and zero history gets capped at tiny jobs until it builds a track record. Creating a hundred fake agents then costs a hundred real work histories, and the network spots the clones because their timelines and payment patterns overlap.
